selector.rationale: New left upper lobe opacification and diffuse reticulonodular interstitial prominence on chest radiograph and CT scan, consistent with Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia, especially in the context of HIV-associated immune suppression

rejected.label: Toxoplasmosis
rejected.why: Initial presentation was consistent with toxoplasmosis, but new symptoms and radiographic findings suggest a different opportunistic infection

rejected.label: HIV-associated immune suppression
rejected.why: While HIV-associated immune suppression is a underlying condition, it is not a specific diagnosis for the current symptoms

rejected.label: Cytomegalovirus infection
rejected.why: Limited evidence to support this diagnosis, with only one supporting note
